measurement: close before print to close after first full session following

names.notes: Reported after close 2026-08-26: revenue $805M (+11% y/y) vs ~$794M consensus, non-GAAP EPS $1.05 vs ~$0.97 consensus, cRPO +14% y/y to $2.585B -- well past the 11% Q3 guide the panel's bear case hinged on -- and FY27 revenue/EPS guidance both raised above prior Street views. Stock jumped ~19% after hours to $160.45 and kept climbing through the next session to close +28.63%, blowing through the 13.0% implied move by more than 2x. The Neutral / No Edge call scores as a miss under the below-expected-move convention (28.63% >> 13.4% unsigned expected), even though it lands inside the wide 6.7-31.6% band -- this was exactly the 'stock moved hard and the panel had no view' case. The specific red-team reversal (an in-line beat with the Q3 cRPO guide held near 11%, no acceleration) did not fire; the opposite happened -- cRPO accelerated and management raised guidance, which two personas (Fundamental, Options & Positioning) had each flagged at -18 as their own top risk-to-call. The stage-2 preliminary read (+10, mildly bullish) called the direction correctly.

Reported before open 2026-08-27: adjusted EPS $2.70 and revenue $4.9B both beat consensus cleanly, but Q3 adjusted-EPS guidance of $0.80-0.95 landed far below the ~$1.39 Street estimate. Shares gapped down hard at the open (as low as ~$120, roughly -9%) before recovering through the session to close -3.92%, an intraday reversal a close-to-close number alone would hide. The Neutral / No Edge call scores as a hit under the below-expected-move convention (3.92% < 9.9% unsigned expected) but the realised move sits just under the low end of its own 4.9-23.3% band, so the panel's magnitude sizing was too generous even on the down side. The red-team's specific reversal case -- 'a cautious Q3/H2 frame on a headline beat is the single most likely path to a decline' -- is the mechanism that actually fired (weak forward guidance overshadowing a clean beat); only the predicted -10% magnitude overshot what the close-to-close print delivered. The stage-2 preliminary read (-10, mildly bearish) called the direction correctly.

Reported (fiscal Q4 2026) 2026-08-26: revenue ~$757M (+16% y/y), ARR ~$2.55B (+16% y/y), better-than-expected profitability, and an upbeat FY27 revenue guide of $3.18-3.23B with a strong free-cash-flow outlook. Stock rose 6.81%, well inside the 14.49% implied move. The stage-2 preliminary read (-10, mildly bearish) called the wrong direction on a name that was never panelled.

Reported Q2 2026: revenue $4.7M (up from $0.6M a year earlier) on first commercial TRISO fuel deliveries and a growing backlog; still a $3.4M net loss on public-company/growth costs but $102.2M cash and no debt. Stock rose 4.45%, a continuation of the pre-print run toward its 52-week high rather than a sharp reaction -- consistent with this being the panel-ineligible name flagged for thin post-IPO trading history and no options market to anchor a move against. The stage-2 preliminary read (-15, bearish) called the wrong direction.
